title: nhanes-bioimpedance
description:
This repository refits the full 50-frequency bioimpedance spectra from NHANES 1999-2004 (about 13,000 Americans aged 8 to 49) and asks whether the whole spectrum predicts outcomes better than the 50 kHz phase angle that published studies use.

Status: pilot, claimed, not peer reviewed.

Claimed findings include that refitting all 13,276 spectra reproduces CDC's Cole parameters; that a 50 kHz equation predicts DXA lean mass with R^2 ≈ 0.96 on a held-out survey cycle while the full spectrum adds 0.000-0.002; and that in 5,173 adults aged 20-49, 50 kHz phase angle predicts death (hazard ratio 0.66 per degree, adjusted for age and sex) while the full spectrum adds no consistent discrimination.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
